title: AC Gravity LLC wins a DoD contract and Li goes silent

tellings.quote: After Li forms her company with Smalley, AC Gravity LLC, they immediately win a DoD contract.

related.note: Both are about the defense money Li and Smalley's company received. This telling says Li then went silent into secret work; Davis says they took the money and delivered nothing.

plain: A physicist named Ning Li, who worked on the idea of controlling gravity, is said to have founded a company called AC Gravity LLC with a fellow researcher named Larry Smalley in Huntsville, Alabama, and won a contract from the US Department of Defense right away, after which she went quiet. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. He raises it as a hint that the military took her gravity work seriously and may have pulled it out of public view.
